title: We Don't Talk Anymore

cues.en: We don't talk anymore, we don't talk anymore, we don't talk anymore, like we used to do
cues.zh: 我們不再說話了，我們不再說話了，我們不再說話了，就像我們以前一樣
cues.text: We don't talk anymore, we don't talk anymore, we don't talk anymore, like we used to do

cues.en: We don't love anymore, what was all of it for, we don't talk anymore, like we used to do
cues.zh: 我們不再愛了，這一切是為了什麼，我們不再說話，就像我們以前一樣
cues.text: We don't love anymore, what was all of it for, we don't talk anymore, like we used to do

cues.en: I just heard you found the one you been looking, you were looking for
cues.zh: 我剛剛聽說你找到了你一直在尋找的人
cues.text: I just heard you found the one you been looking, you were looking for

cues.en: I wish I would have known that was me, cause even after all this time I still wonder why I can't move on
cues.zh: 我希望我知道那就是我，因為即使過了這麼久我仍然想知道為什麼我不能繼續前進
cues.text: I wish I would have known that was me, cause even after all this time I still wonder why I can't move on

cues.en: Just the way you did so easily, don't wanna know, kind of dress you wearing tonight
cues.zh: 就像你如此輕鬆地做到的那樣，不想知道你今晚穿的是什麼樣的衣服
cues.text: Just the way you did so easily, don't wanna know, kind of dress you wearing tonight

cues.en: If you told an until you're so tight, the way I did before, I know that you should've known your love was a game
cues.zh: 如果你告訴我直到你變得如此緊張，就像我以前那樣，我知道你應該知道你的愛是一場遊戲
cues.text: If you told an until you're so tight, the way I did before, I know that you should've known your love was a game

cues.en: Now I can't get you out in my brain, oh it's such a shame, we don't talk anymore, we don't talk anymore, we don't talk anymore, like we used to do
cues.zh: 現在我無法把你從我的腦海中抹去，哦，真是太遺憾了，我們不再說話了，我們不再說話了，我們不再說話了，就像我們以前那樣
cues.text: Now I can't get you out in my brain, oh it's such a shame, we don't talk anymore, we don't talk anymore, we don't talk anymore, like we used to do

cues.en: We don't love anymore, what was all of it for, we don't talk anymore, like we used to do
cues.zh: 我們不再愛了，這一切是為了什麼，我們不再說話，就像我們以前一樣
cues.text: We don't love anymore, what was all of it for, we don't talk anymore, like we used to do

cues.en: I just hope you're lying next to somebody, and those kind of love you like me, must be a good reason that you're gone
cues.zh: 我只希望你躺在某人身邊，而你喜歡我的那種愛，一定是你離開的一個很好的理由
cues.text: I just hope you're lying next to somebody, and those kind of love you like me, must be a good reason that you're gone

cues.en: But every now and then I think you might want the two, come show up at your door
cues.zh: 但時不時我想你可能會想要兩個，出現在你家門口
cues.text: But every now and then I think you might want the two, come show up at your door

cues.en: But I'm just too afraid that I'll be wrong, so I wanna know, if you're looking new to her eyes, she's holding onto you so tight, the way I did before
cues.zh: 但我太害怕我會錯了，所以我想知道，如果你在她眼中看起來很陌生，她會緊緊地抓住你，就像我以前那樣
cues.text: But I'm just too afraid that I'll be wrong, so I wanna know, if you're looking new to her eyes, she's holding onto you so tight, the way I did before

cues.en: I know that you should've known your love was a game, now I can't get you out in my brain, oh it's such a shame
cues.zh: 我知道你應該知道你的愛情是一場遊戲，現在我無法讓你離開我的大腦，哦，這真是太遺憾了
cues.text: I know that you should've known your love was a game, now I can't get you out in my brain, oh it's such a shame

cues.en: My love was a game, with you so tight, the way I did before, like we used to do
cues.zh: 我的愛是一場遊戲，和你如此緊密，就像我以前做的那樣，就像我們以前做的那樣
cues.text: My love was a game, with you so tight, the way I did before, like we used to do

cues.en: I hope it's old, should I know my love is a game

cues.en: Oh it's such a shame
